    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Buy_Instructions" sourceRef="Task_BuyRemaining" targetRef="Task_ReceiveInstructions"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Instructions_Repair" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveInstructions" targetRef="Task_RepairPhone"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Repair_Worked" sourceRef="Task_RepairPhone" targetRef="Gateway_RepairWorked"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Worked_Yes" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_RepairWorked" targetRef="Gateway_FeedbackChoice">

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Feedback_Review" name="Send a review" sourceRef="Gateway_FeedbackChoice" targetRef="Task_SendReview">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">A review is sent</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Feedback_Video" name="Send a video" sourceRef="Gateway_FeedbackChoice" targetRef="Task_SendVideo">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">A video is sent</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Review_FeedbackMerge" sourceRef="Task_SendReview" targetRef="Gateway_FeedbackMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Video_FeedbackMerge" sourceRef="Task_SendVideo" targetRef="Gateway_FeedbackMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_FeedbackMerge_SuccessEnd" sourceRef="Gateway_FeedbackMerge" targetRef="End_RepairSucceeded"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Expert_End" sourceRef="Task_SendToExpert" targetRef="End_ExpertRepair"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_OnlineTool" name="Online repair tool" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_ToolDetails" name="Receive phone model and damage details">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_ToolDetails" messageRef="Message_PhoneDetails"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_ProvideLists" name="Provide materials, tools and ordering choices"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_ProvideLists" name="Lists and ordering choices provided"/>
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_ProvideInstructions" name="Prepare repair instructions"/>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_ProvideInstructions" name="Provide instructions for fixing the phone"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_ProvideInstructions" name="Repair instructions provided"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ToolDetails_ProvideLists" sourceRef="Start_ToolDetails" targetRef="Task_ProvideLists"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ProvideLists_End" sourceRef="Task_ProvideLists" targetRef="End_ProvideLists"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_StartInstructions_Provide" sourceRef="Start_ProvideInstructions" targetRef="Task_ProvideInstructions"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ProvideInstructions_End" sourceRef="Task_ProvideInstructions" targetRef="End_ProvideInstructions"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" id="Definitions_DIYRepair" targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/diy-smartphone-repair">
  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_DIYRepair">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_DIYRepairer" name="DIY Repairer" processRef="Process_DIYRepair"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Friends" name="Friends"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Expert" name="Repair expert"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_ContactFriends" sourceRef="Task_ContactFriends" targetRef="Participant_Friends"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_SendPhoneToExpert" sourceRef="Task_SendToExpert" targetRef="Participant_Expert"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_DIYRepair" name="DIY Repair of a Broken Smartphone Screen" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_DIYRepair">
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_DIYRepairer" name="DIY Repairer">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Start_Repair</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_EnterDetails</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_CheckPossessions</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_ItemsNeeded</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_ContactFriends</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ContactFriends</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_FriendChoiceMerge</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_BuyRemaining</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_AcquisitionMerge</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_RepairPhone</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_RepairWorked</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_FeedbackChoice</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SendReview</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SendVideo</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_FeedbackMerge</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>End_RepairSucceeded</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SendToExpert</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>End_PhoneSentToExpert</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_OnlineTool" name="Online repair tool">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ProvideLists</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ProvideInstructions</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_Repair" name="Begin DIY repair"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_EnterDetails" name="Enter phone model and what is broken"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ProvideLists" name="Provide materials, tools, and ordering choices"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_CheckPossessions" name="Identify which listed items you already have"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ItemsNeeded" name="Are any listed items still needed?" default="Flow_ItemsNotNeeded"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ContactFriends" name="Contact friends about items?" default="Flow_SkipFriends"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_ContactFriends" name="Contact friends about borrowing or buying items cheaply"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_FriendChoiceMerge" name="Continue after friend-contact choice"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_BuyRemaining" name="Buy the remaining items"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_AcquisitionMerge" name="Continue after obtaining needed items"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ProvideInstructions" name="Provide instructions for fixing the phone"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_RepairPhone" name="Fix the phone using the instructions"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_RepairWorked" name="Did the repair work?"/>
    <bpmn:inclusiveGateway id="Gateway_FeedbackChoice" name="Send a review and/or video"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_SendReview" name="Send a review"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_SendVideo" name="Send a video of you fixing the phone"/>
    <bpmn:inclusiveGateway id="Gateway_FeedbackMerge" name="Finish sending feedback"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_RepairSucceeded" name="Repair worked"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendToExpert" name="Send the phone to an expert"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_PhoneSentToExpert" name="Phone sent to an expert"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Start_Enter" sourceRef="Start_Repair" targetRef="Task_EnterDetails"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Enter_ProvideLists" sourceRef="Task_EnterDetails" targetRef="Task_ProvideLists"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ProvideLists_Check" sourceRef="Task_ProvideLists" targetRef="Task_CheckPossessions"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Check_ItemsNeeded" sourceRef="Task_CheckPossessions" targetRef="Gateway_ItemsNeeded"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ItemsNeeded_Yes" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_ItemsNeeded" targetRef="Gateway_ContactFriends">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">Some listed items are still needed</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ItemsNotNeeded" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_ItemsNeeded" targetRef="Gateway_AcquisitionMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ContactFriends_Yes" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_ContactFriends" targetRef="Task_ContactFriends">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">Choose to contact friends about borrowing or buying items cheaply</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SkipFriends" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_ContactFriends" targetRef="Gateway_FriendChoiceMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ContactFriends_Merge" sourceRef="Task_ContactFriends" targetRef="Gateway_FriendChoiceMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_FriendMerge_Buy" sourceRef="Gateway_FriendChoiceMerge" targetRef="Task_BuyRemaining"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Buy_AcquisitionMerge" sourceRef="Task_BuyRemaining" targetRef="Gateway_AcquisitionMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Acquisition_Instructions" sourceRef="Gateway_AcquisitionMerge" targetRef="Task_ProvideInstructions"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Instructions_Repair" sourceRef="Task_ProvideInstructions" targetRef="Task_RepairPhone"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Repair_Worked" sourceRef="Task_RepairPhone" targetRef="Gateway_RepairWorked"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Worked_Yes" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_RepairWorked" targetRef="Gateway_FeedbackChoice">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">The repair worked</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Worked_No" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_RepairWorked" targetRef="Task_SendToExpert">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">The repair did not work</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Feedback_Review" name="Send a review" sourceRef="Gateway_FeedbackChoice" targetRef="Task_SendReview">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">A review is sent</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Feedback_Video" name="Send a video" sourceRef="Gateway_FeedbackChoice" targetRef="Task_SendVideo">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">A video is sent</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Review_FeedbackMerge" sourceRef="Task_SendReview" targetRef="Gateway_FeedbackMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Video_FeedbackMerge" sourceRef="Task_SendVideo" targetRef="Gateway_FeedbackMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_FeedbackMerge_Success" sourceRef="Gateway_FeedbackMerge" targetRef="End_RepairSucceeded"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Expert_End" sourceRef="Task_SendToExpert" targetRef="End_PhoneSentToExpert"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
